DREAM WORKER — Issue #86: Standardize sendTyping

## Instructions
1. Read the wish file: .genie/wishes/standardize-sendtyping/WISH.md
2. Branch from dev: git checkout dev && git pull origin dev && git checkout -b fix/standardize-sendtyping
3. Execute ALL execution groups. Groups 1-3 are independent, Group 4 depends on all:
   - Group 1: Delete WhatsApp dead code — typing.ts, its exports from index.ts, typing.test.ts
   - Group 2: Discord auto-refresh — implement setInterval every 8s in sendTyping, cleanup on disconnect/destroy, 60s failsafe. Use channelId (not chatId) for the interval Map key
   - Group 3: Telegram auto-refresh — implement setInterval every 4s in sendTyping, cleanup on disconnect/destroy, 60s failsafe
   - Group 4: Document Slack no-op in capabilities.ts, run full make check
4. Run validation commands from the wish after each group
5. Run make check — if it fails, fix and retry (max 3 attempts)
6. Once CI green, create PR: gh pr create --base dev --title "fix(channel-sdk): standardize sendTyping across channels (GH#86)" --body "..."
7. Report back: DONE with PR URL, or BLOCKED with reason

IMPORTANT: Do NOT push to main. PR must target dev.
